newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - P&G target price raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - P&G target price raised.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Heather Hay said she raised the target price for Procter & Gamble Co to $121 over the next 12 months from $101.
-- The analyst said she maintains her estimate of $4.85 per share for fiscal year 1997.
-- She said the current environment and that of 1997 are favorable for the household/personal care group in general.

-- Hay said P&G is not trading at its peak multiple. "We believe, at minimum, that P&G's valuation is sustainable at current levels into 1997. In fact it could expand in light of several fundamentals issues unfolding," Hay said.
-- She said market share numbers look good in the United States and she expects earnings to accelerate and new products to be released in early 1997.
